# Adeep AG

> Open-source developer, hardware builder, and cybersecurity enthusiast from Bengaluru, India. Age 18. Engineering student at Sai Vidya Institute of Technology.

Adeep AG is an 18-year-old engineering student and independent developer based in Bengaluru, India. He builds backend systems, hardware projects, cybersecurity tools, and open-source software. His goal is to build technology startups rather than pursue a traditional engineering career. He has a strong interest in defense technology for its engineering complexity and innovation potential.

## Core Skills

- Backend development (4+ years)
- Electronics and hardware projects
- Cybersecurity systems
- Open-source software development
- Web development (frontend and backend)

## Notable Projects

- **ALogin** — an authentication system built from scratch
- **Novichok** — a cybersecurity-related tool
- **Navis** — an Arduino-based robot car
- Various tools built for organisations

## Achievements

- Won 2 hackathons in the first year of engineering
- Filed a patent (Application No. 202641070548 A) — RFID-Based Public Bus Tracking and Passenger Information System, published in The Gazette of India, June 2026
- IT Head of the Rotaract Club of Sai Vidya Institute of Technology (RCSVIT)
